title.narrative: Bataan Electric Public Transport Program

description.narrative: The Project aims to transform the public land transportation sector within the province of Bataan as low carbon one under the vision of “Carbon-Neutral” Bataan. The plan is to convert the entire public utility bus fleet from diesel-powered bus (and jeepney) to electric buses or other climate-friendly transport technologies, thereby reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and optimizing the level of service that will lead to improved quality for the operators, drivers, and the riding public.
